<p class="owner"><span class="en">Author: Kai Marsh</span><span class="zh">作者：马凯</span></p>

::: {.en .simple-only}
What would an operating and maintenance (O&M) contract at a Victorian waste-to-energy plant earn CDEG, and how fast would it repay the entry budget? The defaults are Model 1's benchmarks. A\$ at today's prices, excluding GST.

[Defaults are indicative estimates from public sources. Enter your own figures: nothing you type is saved or sent anywhere.]{.model-caveat}
:::

::: {.zh .simple-only}
维州垃圾焚烧发电厂的委托运营（O&M）合同能为集团带来多少收益，多快能收回进入预算？默认值采用模型1的基准。当前价格澳元，不含GST。

[默认值为基于公开资料的估算，仅供参考。可输入自己的数据：输入内容不会被保存或发送到任何地方。]{.model-caveat}
:::

::: {.en .dev-only}
What an operating and maintenance (O&M) contract at a Victorian waste-to-energy plant would earn CDEG. The model starts from the running costs in [Model 1](wte-payback.qmd) (the WtE payback model) and chains four steps: **the plant's running costs** that an operator controls give a cost per tonne; **a margin** on top gives the O&M fee; **that fee times licensed tonnes** gives the size of the market; and **one contract's margin** against the entry budget gives CDEG's payback. The defaults are Model 1's benchmark settings, for CDEG to replace with its own operating cost. All money is A\$ at today's prices, excluding GST. The results bar at the bottom of the screen updates as you move any control.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}
测算维州一座垃圾焚烧发电厂的委托运营（O&M）合同能为集团带来多少收益。模型以[模型1](wte-payback.qmd)（垃圾发电项目回收期模型）的运营成本为起点，分四步串联：运营方可控的**工厂运营成本**得出每吨成本；加上**利润率**得出运营费；**运营费乘以许可吨数**得出市场规模；**一份合同的利润**与进入预算相比得出集团的回收期。默认值采用模型1的基准设定，集团可用自己的运营成本替换。所有金额为当前价格澳元，不含GST。屏幕底部的结果栏会随任何参数变化而实时更新。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Use the locally bundled libraries instead of Observable's CDN defaults
Inputs = window.Inputs
Plot = window.Plot
d3 = window.d3
html = window.htl.html
// Label that switches with the language button (CSS shows one span)
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
C = ({base: "#2a78d6", low: "#eb6834", high: "#1baf7a", grey: "#9a9890", dark: "#0b0b0b"})
fmtM = v => (v / 1e6).toFixed(1)
kt = v => (v / 1e3).toFixed(0)
// Chinese figures use 万 and 亿 (groups of four digits) instead of k and m
wan = x => { const s = x < 0 ? "−" : "", a = Math.abs(x); return s + (a >= 1e8 ? `${(a/1e8).toFixed(2)}亿` : a >= 1e6 ? `${(a/1e4).toFixed(0)}万` : a >= 1e4 ? `${(a/1e4).toFixed(1)}万` : d3.format(",.0f")(a)); }
perT = (x, d = 0) => T(`A$${x.toFixed(d)}/t`, `${x.toFixed(d)}澳元/吨`)
mA = v => T(`A$${fmtM(v)}m`, `${wan(v)}澳元`)
tile = (label, value, sub, warn) => html`<div class="kpi" style="${warn ? "border-color:#eb6834;background:#fdf1ec" : ""}"><div class="kpi-label">${label}</div><div class="kpi-value">${value}</div><div class="kpi-sub">${sub ?? ""}</div></div>`
// Victorian WtE licences, August 2025 (same figures as Model 1)
LIC = ({total: v("lic_total") * 1e6, cleanaway: v("lic_cleanaway") * 1e3, hiq: v("lic_hiq") * 1e3, mw: v("lic_mw") * 1e3})
// Metro Vancouver contractor-run plant, C$93–112/t ≈ A$100–125/t, excluding ash and debt service
VANCOUVER = [100, 125]
// Cache-busting: Cloudflare caches data files for hours; the page's Last-Modified changes on every deploy
V = "?v=" + encodeURIComponent(document.lastModified)
// ----- Assumptions register: defaults and sources for every input (data/assumptions.csv + data/sources.csv) -----
// A failed fetch falls back to DEFAULTS (with a warning) instead of blanking the page
csvStrict = path => fetch(path).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); }).then(t => d3.csvParse(t, d3.autoType))
registerRes = Promise.all([csvStrict("../data/assumptions.csv" + V), csvStrict("../data/sources.csv" + V)]).then(([a, s]) => ({a, s, ok: true}), () => ({a: [], s: [], ok: false}))
registerFailed = !registerRes.ok
A = Object.fromEntries(registerRes.a.map(d => [d.id, d]))
REF = Object.fromEntries(registerRes.s.map(d => [d.id, d.ref]))
// Fallback defaults (same values as data/assumptions.csv) so a missing row cannot blank the page
DEFAULTS = ({lic_cleanaway: 760, lic_hiq: 750, lic_mw: 450, lic_total: 2.35, o_budget: 9.6, o_discount: 0.08, o_markup: 0.125, o_owner_share: 0, o_range_high: 110, o_range_low: 60, o_self_op: 0.5, o_term: 10, w_availability: 0.9, w_fixed_furnace: 5, w_fixed_site: 3, w_furnaces: 3, w_tpd: 500, w_var_opex: 30})
num = x => typeof x === "number" && Number.isFinite(x)
missingIds = Object.keys(DEFAULTS).filter(id => !num(A[id]?.value)).map(id => A[id] && A[id].value != null ? `${id} (invalid)` : id)
// The CSV wins; DEFAULTS are used only when a row is missing or its value is not a finite number
v = id => num(A[id]?.value) ? A[id].value : DEFAULTS[id]
// Source tag after a label: report reference number(s) linked to the Sources page; an input with no source is an assumption
tag = id => {
  if (!A[id]) return "";
  const refs = String(A[id].source_id ?? "").split(/[;\s]+/).filter(Boolean).map(s => REF[s]).filter(Boolean);
  return refs.length
    ? html`<span class="src-tag">[${refs.map((r, i) => html`${i ? ", " : ""}<a href="../appendix/sources.html#ref-${r}">${r}</a>`)}]</span>`
    : html`<a class="src-tag" href="../appendix/assumptions.html#a-${id}">${L("[Ass.]", "[假设]")}</a>`;
}
lab = (id, en, zh) => html`${L(en, zh)} ${tag(id)}`
// Chart width: full content width in key-inputs mode (charts sit below the inputs), 640 beside the controls in developer mode
PW = mode === "dev" ? 640 : Math.max(640, width)

```

//| echo: false
//| output: false
// ---------- Key-inputs vs developer mode bookkeeping ----------
keyCount = 11
// Advanced inputs (hidden in key-inputs mode; their values still count): [element, current value, default]
advSpec = [
  [viewof tpd, tpd, v("w_tpd")], [viewof fixedSite, fixedSite, v("w_fixed_site")], 
  [viewof discount, discount, v("o_discount")]
]
advCount = advSpec.length
// Compare after snapping the default to the slider's own step/range, so an untouched slider never counts as changed
snap = (el, x) => { const i = el.querySelector("input[type=range]"); if (!i) return x; const lo = +i.min, hi = +i.max, st = +i.step || 0; let y = Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x)); if (st) y = lo + Math.round((y - lo) / st) * st; return y; }
advChanged = advSpec.filter(([el, val, def]) => typeof def === "number" ? Math.abs(val - snap(el, def)) > 1e-9 : val !== def)
resetAdv = () => {
  for (const [el, , def] of advSpec) { el.value = def; el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); }
}
```

## [1 · Running cost the operator controls]{.en}[1 · 运营方可控的运营成本]{.zh}

::: {.en .dev-only}
The operator pays for staff, maintenance and consumables. We assume the owner pays for pre-sorting, ash disposal and reagents directly, so they are left out. Fixed costs are paid whatever the load, so the cost per tonne falls as availability rises.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}
运营方承担人员、维护和耗材费用。假设预分拣、灰渣处置和药剂由业主直接支付，因此不计入。固定成本与负荷无关，因此可用率越高，每吨成本越低。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof furnaces = Inputs.range([1, 6], {value: v("w_furnaces"), step: 1, label: lab("w_furnaces", "Furnaces", "焚烧炉数量")})
viewof availability = Inputs.range([0.75, 0.95], {value: v("w_availability"), step: 0.01, label: lab("w_availability", "Availability", "可用率")})
viewof fixedFurnace = Inputs.range([2, 12], {value: v("w_fixed_furnace"), step: 0.5, label: lab("w_fixed_furnace", "Fixed cost per furnace (A$m/yr)", "单炉固定成本（百万澳元/年）")})
viewof varOpex = Inputs.range([10, 60], {value: v("w_var_opex"), step: 5, label: lab("w_var_opex", "Variable cost (A$/t burned)", "变动成本（澳元/吨）")})
```

<div class="adv-input"><p class="ctl-group"><span class="en">Plant size and site cost assumptions (same defaults as Model 1)</span><span class="zh">工厂规模与厂区成本假设（与模型1默认值相同）</span></p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof tpd = Inputs.range([300, 750], {value: v("w_tpd"), step: 50, label: lab("w_tpd", "Furnace size (t/day)", "单炉规模（吨/日）")})
viewof fixedSite = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: v("w_fixed_site"), step: 0.5, label: lab("w_fixed_site", "Site overhead (A$m/yr)", "厂区管理费用（百万澳元/年）")})
```

</div>
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
costAt = (n, avail) => {
  const tonnes = n * tpd * 365 * avail;
  const fixed = (n * fixedFurnace + fixedSite) * 1e6;
  return {tonnes, fixed, fixedT: fixed / tonnes};
}
plant = costAt(furnaces, availability)
// Spares and consumables the owner may supply directly (section 2) come off the variable cost
costT = plant.fixedT + varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)
{
  const curve = d3.range(0.75, 0.951, 0.01).map(a => ({a, fixed: costAt(furnaces, a).fixedT, total: costAt(furnaces, a).fixedT + varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)}));
  return Plot.plot({
  width: PW,
    height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {label: T("Availability", "可用率"), tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
    y: {label: T("A$ per tonne", "澳元/吨"), grid: true, domain: [0, d3.max(curve, d => d.total) * 1.1]},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(curve, {x: "a", y: "fixed", fill: C.base, fillOpacity: 0.2}),
      Plot.line(curve, {x: "a", y: "fixed", stroke: C.base, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.line(curve, {x: "a", y: "total", stroke: C.dark, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot([{a: availability, total: costT}], {x: "a", y: "total", r: 5, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.text([curve[0]], {x: "a", y: "fixed", text: () => T("Fixed", "固定成本"), dy: 12, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fill: "#1d5aa6"}),
      Plot.text([curve[0]], {x: "a", y: "total", text: () => T("Fixed + variable", "固定 + 变动"), dy: -8, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.tip(curve, Plot.pointerX({x: "a", y: "total", title: d => `${T("Availability", "可用率")}: ${Math.round(d.a * 100)}%\n${T("Fixed", "固定成本")}: A$${d.fixed.toFixed(0)}/t\n${T("Operator total", "运营方合计")}: A$${d.total.toFixed(0)}/t`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("Tonnes a year", "年处理量"), T(`${kt(plant.tonnes)} kt`, `${wan(plant.tonnes)}吨`), T(`${furnaces} × ${tpd} t/d × 365 × ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`, `${furnaces} × ${tpd}吨/日 × 365 × ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`))}
  ${tile(T("Fixed cost", "固定成本"), perT(plant.fixedT), T(`A$${(plant.fixed / 1e6).toFixed(1)}m a year`, `每年${wan(plant.fixed)}澳元`))}
  ${tile(T("Variable cost", "变动成本"), perT(varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)), ownerShare > 0 ? T(`A$${varOpex}/t less ${Math.round(ownerShare * 100)}% paid by owner`, `${varOpex}澳元/吨，扣除业主承担的${Math.round(ownerShare * 100)}%`) : T("consumables and maintenance", "耗材与维护"))}
  ${tile(T("Operator-controlled cost", "运营方可控成本"), perT(costT), T("before margin", "未计利润"))}
</div>`
```
:::
::::

::: {.eq-box}
$$c = \frac{n F_n + F_s}{Q} + c_v\,(1 - s_o) \qquad Q = n \times t_d \times 365 \times a$$

::: {.en .eq-defs}
$c$ operator cost per tonne · $n$ furnaces · $F_n$ fixed cost per furnace · $F_s$ site overhead · $Q$ tonnes a year · $c_v$ variable cost · $s_o$ share of spares and consumables the owner buys (section 2) · $t_d$ furnace size (t/day) · $a$ availability.
:::

::: {.zh .eq-defs}
$c$ 运营方每吨成本 · $n$ 焚烧炉数量 · $F_n$ 单炉固定成本 · $F_s$ 厂区管理费用 · $Q$ 年处理量 · $c_v$ 变动成本 · $s_o$ 业主直接采购的备件与耗材比例（第2节） · $t_d$ 单炉规模（吨/日） · $a$ 可用率。
:::
:::

## [2 · The O&M fee: cost plus margin]{.en}[2 · 运营费：成本加利润]{.zh}

::: {.en .dev-only}
The operator's fee is its cost per tonne plus a margin. The chart sets the result against our A\$60–110/t range and against Metro Vancouver's contractor-run plant, which costs about C\$93–112/t (roughly A\$100–125/t) to operate, excluding ash and debt service \[74\]. Vancouver's is an older plant, so it sits at the top of our range.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}
运营费等于运营方每吨成本加利润。图表将结果与我们的60–110澳元/吨区间以及温哥华都会区（Metro Vancouver）委托运营的焚烧厂对比：后者运营成本约93–112加元/吨（约100–125澳元/吨），不含灰渣处置和偿债 \[74\]。该厂较老，因此位于我们区间的上端。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof markup = Inputs.range([0, 0.3], {value: v("o_markup"), step: 0.005, label: lab("o_markup", "Operator margin on cost", "运营方成本加成率")})
viewof ownerShare = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: v("o_owner_share"), step: 0.05, label: lab("o_owner_share", "Share of spares and consumables the owner buys", "业主直接采购的备件与耗材比例")})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Our benchmark range from the research (a reference band, not an input)
rangeLow = v("o_range_low")
rangeHigh = v("o_range_high")
```
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
feeRaw = costT * (1 + markup)
fee = Math.round(feeRaw / 5) * 5
profitT = fee - costT
// Margin as a share of revenue, the basis for CDEG's profit in section 4
netMargin = fee > 0 ? profitT / fee : 0
{
  const rows = [
    {k: T("Our range", "我方区间"), x1: rangeLow, x2: rangeHigh, c: C.grey},
    {k: T("Metro Vancouver", "温哥华都会区"), x1: VANCOUVER[0], x2: VANCOUVER[1], c: C.high}
  ];
  const ours = T("This model", "本模型");
  return Plot.plot({
  width: PW,
    height: 170, marginLeft: 110,
    x: {label: T("A$ per tonne", "澳元/吨"), grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(150, fee * 1.1)]},
    y: {label: null, domain: [ours, ...rows.map(d => d.k)]},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(rows, {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "c", fillOpacity: 0.5}),
      Plot.barX([{k: ours, x1: 0, x2: costT}], {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.base, fillOpacity: 0.35}),
      Plot.barX([{k: ours, x1: costT, x2: Math.max(fee, costT)}], {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.base}),
      Plot.text([{k: ours, x: Math.max(fee, costT)}], {y: "k", x: "x", text: () => perT(fee), dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600}),
      Plot.tip([{k: ours}], Plot.pointerY({y: "k", x: () => fee, title: () => `${T("Cost", "成本")}: A$${costT.toFixed(1)}/t\n${T("Margin", "利润")}: A$${profitT.toFixed(1)}/t\n${T("Fee", "运营费")}: A$${fee.toFixed(1)}/t`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

<p class="figure-note"><span class="en">Light blue = operator cost; dark blue = margin.</span><span class="zh">浅蓝 = 运营方成本；深蓝 = 利润。</span></p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("O&M fee", "运营费"), perT(fee), T(`A$${feeRaw.toFixed(1)}/t before rounding to A$5`, `取整至5澳元前为${feeRaw.toFixed(1)}澳元/吨`), fee < rangeLow || fee > rangeHigh)}
  ${tile(T("Margin per tonne", "每吨利润"), perT(profitT, 1), T(`${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the fee`, `占运营费${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}%`), profitT <= 0)}
  ${tile(T("Against our range", "与我方区间对比"), fee < rangeLow ? T("Below", "低于") : fee > rangeHigh ? T("Above", "高于") : T("Inside", "区间内"), T(`A$${rangeLow}–${rangeHigh}/t`, `${rangeLow}–${rangeHigh}澳元/吨`), fee < rangeLow || fee > rangeHigh)}
</div>`
```

::::

::: {.eq-box}
$$\phi = c\,(1 + \mu)$$

::: {.en .eq-defs}
$\phi$ O&M fee per tonne, rounded to the nearest A\$5 · $\mu$ margin.
:::

$\phi$ 每吨运营费，取整至5澳元 · $\mu$ 利润率。

## [3 · Market size: tonnes × fee]{.en}[3 · 市场规模：吨数 × 运营费]{.zh}

::: {.en .dev-only}
Seven Victorian licences cover 2.35 Mt a year. Three large holders (Cleanaway 760 kt, HiQ 750 kt and Melbourne Water 450 kt) have not named an operator. HiQ's furnace vendor, Kanadevia Inova, can offer O&M with its grates, so it may never go to tender. Some owners will run their plants themselves.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}

## [4 · CDEG's profit and payback]{.en}[4 · 集团利润与回收期]{.zh}

::: {.en .dev-only}
CDEG's profit on one contract is the margin per tonne times the contract's tonnes. The entry budget is A\$9.6m over 2027–29 (Table 15 in the go-to-market section). Payback counts years of O&M profit needed to repay it, which starts about 2030–31.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}
集团在一份合同上的利润等于每吨利润乘以合同吨数。进入预算为2027–29年共960万澳元（进入市场章节表15）。回收期为收回该预算所需的运营利润年数，运营收入约从2030–31年开始。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}

viewof budget = Inputs.range([3, 20], {value: v("o_budget"), step: 0.1, label: lab("o_budget", "Entry budget (A$m)", "进入预算（百万澳元）")})
viewof term = Inputs.range([5, 25], {value: v("o_term"), step: 1, label: lab("o_term", "Contract length (years)", "合同期限（年）")})

```

</div>

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
contractT = ({two: costAt(2, availability).tonnes, mw: LIC.mw, plant: plant.tonnes})[contract]
revenue = contractT * fee
profit = contractT * profitT
budgetA = budget * 1e6
payback = profit > 0 ? budgetA / profit : null
// Budget spent before the contract starts; profit from year 1 of the contract, discounted to its start
npv = d3.sum(d3.range(1, term + 1), y => profit / (1 + discount) ** y) - budgetA
cum = [{y: 0, c: -budgetA}, ...d3.range(1, term + 1).map(y => ({y, c: -budgetA + profit * y}))]
Plot.plot({
  width: PW,
  height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: T("Contract year", "合同年份"), tickFormat: d => String(d)},
  y: {label: T("Cumulative A$m", "累计百万澳元"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#52514e"}),
    Plot.barY(cum, {x: "y", y: "c", fill: d => d.c >= 0 ? C.high : C.low, fillOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.tip(cum, Plot.pointerX({x: "y", y: "c", title: d => `${T("Year", "第")} ${d.y}${T("", "年")}\n${T("Cumulative", "累计")}: A$${fmtM(d.c)}m`}))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

T(`2 × ${tpd} t/d at ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`, `2 × ${tpd}吨/日，可用率${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`) : contract === "mw" ? T("Melbourne Water licence", "Melbourne Water许可量") : T(`${furnaces} furnaces`, `${furnaces}台炉`))}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// NPV of the chosen contract across O&M fees; cost per tonne held at section 1's value
annuity = d3.sum(d3.range(1, term + 1), y => 1 / (1 + discount) ** y)
npvAt = f => (f - costT) * contractT * annuity - budgetA
breakEven = costT + budgetA / (contractT * annuity)
{
  const sens = d3.range(40, 141, 1).map(f => ({f, npv: npvAt(f)}));
  return Plot.plot({
  width: PW,
    height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {label: T("O&M fee (A$/t)", "运营费（澳元/吨）"), grid: true},
    y: {label: T("NPV (A$m)", "净现值（百万澳元）"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
    marks: [
      Plot.rectX([{x1: rangeLow, x2: rangeHigh}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.grey, fillOpacity: 0.12}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#52514e"}),
      Plot.ruleX([breakEven], {stroke: C.low, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
      Plot.line(sens, {x: "f", y: "npv", stroke: C.base, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot([{f: fee, npv: npvAt(fee)}], {x: "f", y: "npv", r: 5, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.text([{f: breakEven}], {x: "f", y: () => npvAt(140), text: () => T(`Break-even A$${breakEven.toFixed(0)}/t`, `盈亏平衡 ${breakEven.toFixed(0)}澳元/吨`), dx: -6, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 11, fill: "#b4471b"}),
      Plot.tip(sens, Plot.pointerX({x: "f", y: "npv", title: d => `${T("O&M fee", "运营费")}: A$${d.f}/t\n${T("Margin", "利润")}: A$${(d.f - costT).toFixed(1)}/t\nNPV: A$${fmtM(d.npv)}m`}))
    ]
  });
}

::: {.eq-box}
$$\Pi = Q_k\,(\phi - c) \qquad Y = \frac{B}{\Pi} \qquad \text{NPV} = \sum_{t=1}^{T} \frac{\Pi}{(1+r)^t} - B$$

::: {.en .eq-defs}
$\Pi$ CDEG's profit a year · $Q_k$ the contract's tonnes · $Y$ payback (years) · $B$ entry budget · $T$ contract length · $r$ discount rate.
:::

::: {.zh .eq-defs}
$\Pi$ 集团年利润 · $Q_k$ 合同吨数 · $Y$ 回收期（年） · $B$ 进入预算 · $T$ 合同期限 · $r$ 折现率。
:::
:::

## [Method and limits]{.en}[方法与局限]{.zh}

::: {.en .simple-only}
Each chart's equation is shown under it. For the full method, data sources and limits, switch to **All inputs (developer)** at the top of the page.
:::

::: {.zh .simple-only}
每张图下方列出其计算公式。完整的方法、数据来源和局限，请在页面顶部切换到**全部参数（开发者）**。
:::

::: {.en .dev-only}
- **Operator-controlled cost** = (fixed cost per furnace × furnaces + site overhead) ÷ tonnes a year + variable cost. Tonnes a year = furnaces × furnace size × 365 × availability. At the defaults (3 × 500 t/d at 90%), fixed costs of A\$18m a year over 492,750 t are about A\$37/t, plus A\$30/t variable, about A\$67/t in all \[26\].
- **Left out**: pre-sorting (A\$15/t in Model 1), ash disposal and reagents, which we assume the owner pays directly.
- **O&M fee** = operator cost × (1 + margin), rounded to the nearest A\$5. A 10–15% margin gives about A\$74–77/t; the default 12.5% rounds to A\$75/t \[Assumption\].
- **Benchmark**: Metro Vancouver's contractor-run plant costs about C\$93–112/t (roughly A\$100–125/t) to operate, excluding ash and debt service \[74\] \[Industry\]. It is an older plant, so we put it at the top of our A\$60–110/t range.
- **Market sizes** use the August 2025 licences (2.35 Mt in all) and the one fee per tonne from section 2 for every plant.
- **Contracts** also use that one cost and fee per tonne, from the plant in section 1. A two-line plant or Melbourne Water's plant would have a somewhat different cost per tonne, because fixed costs spread over fewer tonnes.
- **Payback** = entry budget ÷ annual profit, with no discounting, counted from the first contract year (about 2030–31). **NPV** discounts the contract's profit to its start and subtracts the budget there; it ignores that the budget is spent two to three years earlier. The 10-year contract length and 8% discount rate are our assumptions. The NPV-vs-fee chart holds the operator's cost per tonne fixed and changes only the fee.
- **Not modelled**: availability bonuses and penalties, liability under guarantees, performance bonds, plant-crew mobilisation (usually paid by the owner [to verify]{.verify}), tax, and inflation.

**What would change these numbers.** The A\$5m per furnace and A\$30/t inputs are benchmark settings in Model 1, not quotes from operators. The 10–15% margin is an assumption. A\$75/t is a whole-plant running cost: the operator's fee alone could be lower if the owner pays for spares and consumables directly (the owner-share slider in section 2 tests this). CDEG's real operating cost per tonne should replace these defaults [to verify]{.verify}.
:::

::: {.zh .dev-only}
- **运营方可控成本** =（单炉固定成本 × 炉数 + 厂区管理费用）÷ 年处理量 + 变动成本。年处理量 = 炉数 × 单炉规模 × 365 × 可用率。按默认值（3台500吨/日、可用率90%），每年1,800万澳元固定成本分摊到492,750吨，约37澳元/吨，加上30澳元/吨变动成本，合计约67澳元/吨 \[26\]。
- **不计入**：预分拣（模型1中为15澳元/吨）、灰渣处置和药剂，假设由业主直接支付。
- **运营费** = 运营方成本 ×（1 + 利润率），取整至5澳元。10–15%的利润率对应约74–77澳元/吨；默认12.5%取整为75澳元/吨 \[假设\]。
- **基准**：温哥华都会区委托运营的焚烧厂运营成本约93–112加元/吨（约100–125澳元/吨），不含灰渣处置和偿债 \[74\] \[行业\]。该厂较老，因此位于我们60–110澳元/吨区间的上端。
- **市场规模**采用2025年8月的许可量（合计235万吨），所有电厂均采用第2节的同一每吨运营费。
- **合同**同样采用第1节电厂的每吨成本和运营费。两条线电厂或Melbourne Water电厂的每吨成本会略有不同，因为固定成本分摊到的吨数较少。
- **回收期** = 进入预算 ÷ 年利润，不折现，自合同第一年（约2030–31年）起算。**净现值**将合同利润折现至合同开始时，并在该时点扣除预算；未考虑预算实际上提前两到三年支出。10年合同期限和8%折现率为我们的假设。净现值–运营费图保持运营方每吨成本不变，仅改变运营费。
- **未建模**：可用率奖惩、担保责任、履约保函、电厂运营团队进场费用（通常由业主承担 [待核实]{.verify}）、税费和通胀。

**哪些因素会改变结果。** 单炉500万澳元和30澳元/吨是模型1的基准设定，而非运营商报价。10–15%的利润率为假设。75澳元/吨是全厂运营成本：如果业主直接支付备件和耗材，运营方的服务费本身可能更低（可用第2节的业主采购比例滑块测试）。应以集团实际的每吨运营成本替换这些默认值 [待核实]{.verify}。
:::
